Vegetarian Tom Kha A rich, creamy and fragrant Thai coconut soup loaded with veggies and paneer. It’s super easy to make, completely vegetarian, and packed with those beautiful Thai flavours we all love.
If you’re a Thai curry fan, you definitely need to try this one! Enjoy it as a comforting soup on its own or pair it with some rice for a wholesome meal. Do give it a try. Happy Cooking!

Veg Tom Kha
Prep Time: 15-20 minutes
Cooking Time: 20–25 minutes
Serving: 4-5 people
